Chapter 818: Chapter 20 Child Of The Void (Please Subscribe)_3

Chapter 818: Chapter 20 Child of the Void (Please Subscribe)_3

“The Tianzhi True Lord last contacted me, saying he had discovered traces of the Martial Tao origins.”

“Perhaps he was delayed in his search for the Martial Tao origins.”

The Eastern Wing Lord speculated in his heart, never had he anticipated any accidents befalling the Tianzhi True Lord.

The Tianzhi True Lord is a Perfect Demon True Lord with extremely strong life-preserving methods. Who could silently take down the Tianzhi True Lord without notice?

Moreover, the Tianzhi True Lord has an ‘incarnation’ placed in the deepest area of the Void Secret Realm for the purpose of preserving life; if the Tianzhi True Lord indeed encountered any mishaps, the incarnation could still make contact with them.

“Then let’s wait a bit longer.”

...

Lord Divine Eye glanced at the other Demonic Divine Masters.

Without the leadership of the Tianzhi True Lord, the dozen or so Perfect Demon True Lords were not entirely confident they could besiege the Taiyin Sovereign.

And should they fail, the consequences would be severe, facing the full-force retaliation of the Taiyin Sovereign.

“Let’s wait.”

The Eastern Wing Lord nodded.

By now, apart from waiting, there weren’t any better options.

…

Time slowly passed.

In the blink of an eye, another fifty years had gone by.

It was still that piece of the Void; the Eastern Wing Lord and the dozen or so Perfect Demon True Lords were still gathered here.

“What on earth is going on?”

“Fifty years have passed, and Tianzhi has still not contacted me?”

The Eastern Wing Lord felt increasingly uneasy in his heart. To a Demon Lord, fifty years were but a fleeting moment, yet during this critical time to besiege the Taiyin Sovereign,

Tianzhi True Lord had not sent any message for fifty years, which was certainly irregular.

Even if the Tianzhi True Lord was busy, could he really not spare a moment to reply to them in fifty years?

“What do we do?”

Lord Divine Eye asked with a grave expression, looking towards the Eastern Wing Lord for guidance.

“I will go to see Tianzhi True Lord’s life-preserving incarnation.”

The Eastern Wing Lord spoke up.

Tianzhi True Lord’s mysterious disappearance to date, while the Eastern Wing Lord could not find his true body, he did know where the life-preserving incarnation was located.

That was the deepest area of the Void Secret Realm, which could be considered the Core of the Secret Realm, a place theoretically absolutely safe.

This was precisely why Tianzhi True Lord’s ‘incarnation’ left there could be aptly called a ‘life-preserving incarnation.’

“Go to see Tianzhi’s ‘life-preserving incarnation’?”

Lord Divine Eye was slightly stunned, immediately saying: “We cannot enter the deepest area of the Void Secret Realm.”

If any Perfect Demon True Lord could enter the location of the life-preserving incarnation, it could hardly be called ‘life-preserving.’

“I know.”

“That’s why I plan to awaken the great Child of the Void.”

The Eastern Wing Lord fell silent for a while before speaking.

“The Child of the Void?”

Lord Divine Eye and the other True Lords’ expressions changed.

The Child of the Void is the master of the Void Secret Realm; they cannot enter the deepest areas of the Void Secret Realm, but the Child of the Void can.

Currently, most of the Perfect Demon True Lords were able to place their incarnations in the deepest part of the Void Secret Realm, becoming ‘life-preserving incarnations’ because they were permitted by the Child of the Void.

Aside from the ‘life-preserving incarnations’ actively contacting the outside world, only the Child of the Void could forcefully make contact with the ‘life-preserving incarnations.’

“Are you sure?”

Lord Divine Eye asked seriously.

Awakening the Child of the Void was no trivial matter.

To awaken without cause was to receive punishment from the Child of the Void.

“I’m sure.”

The Eastern Wing Lord nodded, the Tianzhi True Lord had been missing for so long, there must be a serious issue, even at the risk of receiving the Child of the Void’s punishment, he needed to find clarity in this matter.

“If that is the case, we will head to the Void Secret Realm right now.”

Lord Divine Eye said immediately.

…

Deep inside the Void Secret Realm.

This place was already the limit that a normal Evil God could explore; further inside was a domain that they couldn’t enter, it was the resting place of the strongest Demonic Divine Masters of the Boundless Void.

“Great Child of the Void…”

The Eastern Wing Lord immediately began to call for the Child of the Void.

As a Perfect Demon True Lord, the Eastern Wing Lord naturally had the means to summon the Child of the Void, and most of the Perfect Demon True Lords also had this capability.

However, no Perfect Demon True Lord dared to use this method lightly; after all, we are dealing with the Child of the Void.

Woo woo woo~

An invisible aura began to converge.

In a daze, a tremendous will descended from the deepest part of the Void Secret Realm.

“Who is it? Who is awakening me?”

The entirety of the Void Secret Realm trembled slightly, at that moment, all the Perfect Demon True Lords were shocked and looked towards this place, realizing immediately that the Child of the Void had awakened.

Whirr.

An infinite power of the Void Secret Realm began to condense, forming a majestic figure that looked down upon Eastern Wing Lord and the dozen or so True Lords.

“Greetings, Child of the Void.”

The Eastern Wing Lord immediately said respectfully.

Although the Child of the Void was also a Perfect Demon True Lord, with control over the Void Secret Realm, the strength of the Child of the Void was entirely above all other Perfect Demon True Lords.

For the Eastern Wing Lord and the other True Lords, the Child of the Void was no different from the Tenth Stage Evil Gods.

“Speak.”

The majestic figure formed by the will of the Child of the Void looked on with a calm gaze.

“Yes.”

The Eastern Wing Lord quickly delineated the recent few hundred years of events, especially highlighting the disappearance of Tianzhi True Lord, expressly indicating a major problem arose.

“The Taiyin Sovereign?”

“The Martial Tao cultivation system?”

The Child of the Void was momentarily stunned, then revealed a trace of a smile, “Interesting, I have never heard of the name Taiyin Sovereign.”

“Even the great Child of the Void has not heard of it?”

The Eastern Wing Lord was slightly taken aback, assuming that the Taiyin Sovereign had accidentally fallen into the deepest part of the Void Secret Realm, and cultivated to the Ninth Stage Perfection there, so there had been no traces left in the Boundless Void.

But if even the Child of the Void did not know of the Taiyin Sovereign, this possibility no longer stood.

“You wish to inquire about Tianzhi? I shall question Tianzhi’s life-preserving incarnation now.”

The Child of the Void dispatched a wisp of will, descending to the deepest area of the Void Secret Realm, arriving at the location of Tianzhi True Lord’s life-preserving incarnation.

“Eh?”

The Child of the Void’s brow raised slightly, displaying a look of surprise.
